newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end higher, consolidate, trade sparse.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end higher, consolidate, trade sparse.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed a thinly traded session higher as prices consolidated in the wake of last week's losses.
Light local and speculative buying carried November delivery up 0.70 cent to close at 111.95 cents a lb. The back months settled 0.10 to 0.75 higher.
Trade scale up selling capped the market and prevented prices from breaking out of their recent range. November support was pegged at 107.00 and resistance at 116.00.
Friday, the market closed sharply lower after USDA put the 1996/97 crop at 220 million 90-lb boxes, at the high end of market expectations.
